messages:
jamie (AE): Quick heads-up — starting POC with Nordica Bank tomorrow. They insist on EU-only data residency + a list of subprocessors for their legal. Also asked whether we can pin their tenant to eu-west-1 and have failover to eu-central only. Asking: 1) official subprocessor list for EU regions, 2) routing policy example for tenant pin + failover, 3) any pricing delta for regional pin/dedicated capacity. cc @lara

lara (SE): Thanks, jamie. Two quick clarifications: what models/throughput are they expecting (tokens/sec)? are they okay with Dedicated vs Private? If low latency and strict residency, Dedicated capacity pinned to eu-west-1 is typical. We can do a tenant pin + failover only to eu-central — that would be a routing policy. Also BYOK KMS is possible for Private/Dedicated.

jamie (AE): They want gpt-like open models (LLama-variants) 20 concurrent reqs, peak ~300 req/min. Prefer hosted but will accept Dedicated if needed. BYOK is a must for keys.

sam (Legal): Sharing the EU subprocessor pack: https://redwood.internal/docs/subprocessors/eu-2026.pdf — includes cloud infra, CDN, monitoring vendors. For deals we send the attestation template; I can prep a signed attestation for Nordica if SE confirms the exact regions and whether BYOK will be used. :white_check_mark:

devon (Infra): For routing policy example, paste below. This is what we typically hand to customers to show pin+failover:

```
{
  "routing_policy": "tenant_pin",
  "pinned_region": "eu-west-1",
  "failover_regions": ["eu-central-1"],
  "subprocessor_scope": "eu-only",
  "egress": {
    "allow_cross_border": false,
    "egress_cost_estimate": "+€0.02/token"
  }
}
```

Note: if they require strict egress (no cross-border), we must ensure CDN/caching layers also sit in eu regions; that can add cost and 2-3 day ops prep. Certificates and peering require customer network details.

ella (Pricing): Rough delta: pinning to dedicated eu pool vs standard hosted — about +€4k/month for reserved capacity sized for 20 concurrent (approx). If they want BYOK + HSM-backed KMS we'll add a one-time setup of ~€2k and +€200/month for key management / rotation support. I can run a precise quote if you confirm SLA and retention.

jamie (AE): Great — please do the signed attestation, sam. Lara/Devon — can you confirm we can support the model families (LLama variants) with quantization in dedicated eu-west pinned pool? Any perf concerns at 300rpm?

lara (SE): We can. We'll use int8 quantization and the runtime supports continuous batching; expected p95 latency ~180-300ms on dedicated A100-class pool for that workload. I'll send a small perf note and the canary checklist. Also will schedule a short sync with Nordica's infra lead tomorrow 11:00 CET. 

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-config for nordica-poc -> eu-west-1 at 11:05 CET (automated). :gear:

jamie (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and push for signatures. Assigning follow-ups: @sam will do attestation, @ella will send quote, @lara & @devon will run the 11:00 sync and perf note. Back soon.
